table.note: no table: no column was matched to a sample; agent: The STAR readcount file has whole-number counts per gene, with N_unmapped, N_multimapping and N_noFeature rows, so it holds raw read counts. No sample is given in sources, because each of the 4 GSM samples has three replicate columns (R1–R3) and no single column holds a whole sample; the FPKM and rlog files are normalised.
